## ✅ PR Checklist

### 🏷 Branch & Naming
- [ ] Branch follows naming convention (`feature/TC-XXX-description`)
- [ ] Branch was created from `develop` (not `main`)

### 🧪 Test Quality
- [ ] Test runs successfully locally in Katalon Studio
- [ ] No hardcoded URLs, credentials, or environment values
- [ ] Execution Profile used for all environment-specific config
- [ ] Object Repository updated if new locators were added
- [ ] Custom Keywords reused where applicable

### 🚀 CI/CD
- [ ] GitHub Actions pipeline passes on this branch
- [ ] Smoke Tests job is green 🔥
- [ ] No unrelated files changed in this PR

### 📖 Documentation
- [ ] PR description complete with ticket ID and summary
- [ ] Test case ID referenced in commit message(s)
- [ ] README updated if new setup/profiles added

### 🔍 Review Ready
- [ ] Self-reviewed the diff before requesting review
- [ ] All comments/conversations resolved
- [ ] No WIP items remaining
